title: Short exact comparison complexes for external cup in the left coefficient
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ and $g:Y\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ morphisms of quasi-compact schemes [def-pc-scheme] with affine diagonals. Let $S=(F\to E\to Q)$ be a short exact sequence [def-weil-pbc-exact-sequence] of quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-modules [pqf-def-coherent], and $G$ a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_Y$-module. For $M\in\{F,E,Q\}$ let $T_M=\operatorname{picardExternalTotal}(f,g,M,G)$ and $P_M=\operatorname{picardScalarModel}(f\circ\operatorname{pr}_1,\operatorname{pr}_1^*M\otimes\operatorname{pr}_2^*G)$ as in [lem-sc-picard-external-cup-cochain] and [lem-sc-picard-kunneth-resolution-model]. There exist normalized cochain maps $d_M:T_M\to P_M$ (the normalization predicate of [lem-sc-picard-external-cup-cochain]), short exact sequences $A,B$ of integer cochain complexes of $k$-vector spaces, and a short-complex morphism $\phi:A\to B$. The terms of $A_2,A_3,B_2,B_3$ in negative degrees are zero. For every natural $n$ there are isomorphisms $a_j:H^n(A_j)\cong H^n(T_{M_j})$ and $b_j:H^n(B_j)\cong H^n(P_{M_j})$, where $(M_1,M_2,M_3)=(F,E,Q)$, satisfying $H^n(\phi_j)\,;\,b_j=a_j\,;\,H^n(d_{M_j})$ for $j=1,2,3$. No specified comparison cochain maps, five-term rows, connecting morphisms, or invertibility hypotheses are inputs or conclusions.

source.place: Tag 0BED, lemma-kunneth: short exact coefficient diagram following equation-kunneth-on-cech (33.29.1.1); source read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0BED.

proof.text: Choose finite affine covers U of X and V of Y. Finite intersections are affine by the affine-diagonal criterion. On these intersections quasi-coherent section sequences are short exact: kernels are sectionwise and the affine cokernel formula identifies quotient sections with the module cokernel. The product affine spectrum and pullback/tensor section formulas identify product-coefficient sections with factor section tensors. Field tensor is exact. Finite products over cover indices and finite sums in each total degree preserve exactness. Form the tensor-total Cech sequence A and the product Cech sequence B and extend both by zero to integers. Their negative terms are zero. Pullbacks of quasi-coherent modules are quasi-coherent. To pass from standard pullback to tensorPullback, use uniqueness of left adjoints to pushforward with exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction. Tensor-product quasi-coherence then makes each external product coefficient quasi-coherent, as needed by the affine comparison theorem.

Use exists_unique_cechRefinementMap for the two inverse-image-cover refinements to W. It is k-linear: its sectionwise adjunction unit and restrictions commute with multiplication by the scalar section from k. Use the explicit bilinear cechCupCochain and cechCupCochain_leibniz to obtain the map out of the signed tensor total complex. On each tuple, module morphisms commute with restriction and the tensor section map sends a tensor to the tensor of its images. Naturality of the pullback-adjunction unit proves the refinement coefficient square. These pointwise equalities give commutation with S.f and S.g, so the three components form a short-complex morphism phi:A to B. This constructs the cochain morphism, not a connecting square or five-term homology ladder.

For each natural degree and each coefficient, compose the canonical affine Cech comparison with the scalar-resolution-model comparison to obtain b_j. Scalar restriction preserves homology. Apply tensor Kunneth to the Cech and scalar factor models and the factor comparisons to obtain a_j. The refinement and cup comparison squares identify the transported homology component with externalCup on total cycles coming from pairs of factor cycles.

Choose the three normalized scalar-model cochain maps d_j using picardExternalCupCochain_exists. For any pair of factor homology classes, lift them to cycles using the surjectivity of homology projections. Tensor Kunneth gives a total cycle and identifies its class with that elementary tensor. The normalization of d_j and the comparison squares give the same externalCup value. Pure tensors span each tensor summand and direct-sum inclusions span the direct sum, so linearity proves H(phi.tau_j) followed by b_j equals a_j followed by H(d_j). All comparisons exist in every natural degree; no invertibility of these maps or connecting-map statement is asserted.

lean.statement:
theorem picardExternalCup_left_comparison_complexes
    (k : Type w) [Field k] (X Y : Scheme.{w})
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    [CompactSpace X] [CompactSpace Y]
    [IsAffineHom (pullback.diagonal f)] [IsAffineHom (pullback.diagonal g)]
    (S : ShortComplex X.Modules) (hS : S.ShortExact)
    [S.X₁.IsQuasicoherent] [S.X₂.IsQuasicoherent] [S.X₃.IsQuasicoherent]
    (G : Y.Modules) [G.IsQuasicoherent]
 :
    ∃ (d1 : picardExternalTotal f g S.X₁ G ⟶
        picardScalarModel (pullback.fst f g ≫ f) (externalCupCoefficients f g S.X₁ G))
      (d2 : picardExternalTotal f g S.X₂ G ⟶
        picardScalarModel (pullback.fst f g ≫ f) (externalCupCoefficients f g S.X₂ G))
      (d3 : picardExternalTotal f g S.X₃ G ⟶
        picardScalarModel (pullback.fst f g ≫ f) (externalCupCoefficients f g S.X₃ G)),
      IsPicardExternalCupCochain f g S.X₁ G d1 ∧
      IsPicardExternalCupCochain f g S.X₂ G d2 ∧
      IsPicardExternalCupCochain f g S.X₃ G d3 ∧
      ∃ (A B : ShortComplex (CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{w} k) ℤ))
        (hA : A.ShortExact) (hB : B.ShortExact) (φ : A ⟶ B),
        (∀ p : ℤ, p < 0 →
          IsZero (A.X₂.X p) ∧ IsZero (A.X₃.X p) ∧
          IsZero (B.X₂.X p) ∧ IsZero (B.X₃.X p)) ∧
        ∀ n : ℕ,
          ∃ (a1 : A.X₁.homology (n : ℤ) ≅ (picardExternalTotal f g S.X₁ G).homology
              (n : ℤ))
            (a2 : A.X₂.homology (n : ℤ) ≅ (picardExternalTotal f g S.X₂ G).homology
              (n : ℤ))
            (a3 : A.X₃.homology (n : ℤ) ≅ (picardExternalTotal f g S.X₃ G).homology
              (n : ℤ))
            (b1 : B.X₁.homology (n : ℤ) ≅
              (picardScalarModel (pullback.fst f g ≫ f)
                (externalCupCoefficients f g S.X₁ G)).homology (n : ℤ))
            (b2 : B.X₂.homology (n : ℤ) ≅
              (picardScalarModel (pullback.fst f g ≫ f)
                (externalCupCoefficients f g S.X₂ G)).homology (n : ℤ))
            (b3 : B.X₃.homology (n : ℤ) ≅
              (picardScalarModel (pullback.fst f g ≫ f)
                (externalCupCoefficients f g S.X₃ G)).homology (n : ℤ)),
            HomologicalComplex.homologyMap φ.τ₁ (n : ℤ) ≫ b1.hom =
              a1.hom ≫ HomologicalComplex.homologyMap d1 (n : ℤ) ∧
            HomologicalComplex.homologyMap φ.τ₂ (n : ℤ) ≫ b2.hom =
              a2.hom ≫ HomologicalComplex.homologyMap d2 (n : ℤ) ∧
            HomologicalComplex.homologyMap φ.τ₃ (n : ℤ) ≫ b3.hom =
              a3.hom ≫ HomologicalComplex.homologyMap d3 (n : ℤ)
